n7jbz7t8.speaker: Agent
n7jbz7t8.text: Move along, citizen. Nothing to see here. That is a weather balloon.

n6xw9n4l.speaker: Agent
n6xw9n4l.text: It is a weather balloon. Look into this light for me, please.

nhm9pxdg.speaker: Agent
nhm9pxdg.text: The United States Government thanks you for not asking questions.

choices.text: I wasn't asking a question. I was asking for it.

n87k9bfd.speaker: Agent
n87k9bfd.text: *FLASH* You saw a weather balloon. You are going to the draft office. Have a nice day, Bob.

njqf2r5l.speaker: Agent
njqf2r5l.text: I was afraid you'd say that.

choices.text: (Open the cage) Go on, get out of here.
